A1.justification: Both PDFs are complete, readable 40-page versions of the same AN-GD/IAN-SGD research work. Their text, equations, Table 1, Figures 1–10, and Appendices A–J support reliable comparison.

before.justification: v3 reports original phase-retrieval, Life Expectancy distributionally robust regression, and CIFAR10/ResNet experiments in Section 7, with additional ablations in Appendix A.

after.justification: v4 retains the original experimental results in Section 7 and Appendix A, including convergence comparisons and parameter-sensitivity studies.

M1.justification: The AN-GD and IAN-SGD update rules in Equations (6) and (14) remain unchanged, including adaptive normalization, independent sampling, and clipping.

E1.justification: Both versions evaluate the same synthetic phase-retrieval problem, Life Expectancy regression under DRO, and ResNet18/ResNet50 training on CIFAR10. No dataset, task, or distinct test scenario is added or removed.

E2.justification: Comparator membership is unchanged in corresponding main-text and appendix experiments, including SPIDER in phase retrieval/DRO and Adam and Adagrad in ResNet training.

E3.justification: Section 7.3 changes the reported ResNet18/ResNet50 training durations from 30 epochs to 60 and 80 epochs, respectively. These durations match Figure 3's existing axes in both versions. This is a limited correction to the reported protocol; unchanged plots do not establish that experiments were rerun.

E4.justification: Appendix A retains the same analyses of normalization power, independent-sample batch size, stabilization parameter, noise parameters, and very small batches. Their settings, plots, and findings are unchanged.

E5.justification: Both versions retain the fixed-seed initialization statement in Section 7.3. No repeated-run information, uncertainty-reporting practice, or statistical test is added or revised.

E6.justification: The experimental plot images in Figures 2–10 and their accompanying findings are unchanged. The revised epoch statement is not accompanied by new curves, changed result entries, or different performance rankings.

T1.justification: After Equation (19), v4 adds expectation over the independent normalization sample to the left-hand side and joint expectation over both samples to the right-hand side. This corrects the proof outline's averaging step to agree with Appendix I. The assumptions, theorem statements, and full appendix derivations remain unchanged.

C1.justification: The abstract, contributions, and conclusion retain the same claims about geometry-dependent benefits of adaptive normalization and IAN-SGD achieving O(epsilon^-4) sample complexity under relaxed noise assumptions with constant batch sizes.

C2.justification: The explanations of independent sampling, comparisons between noise assumptions, parameter recommendations, convergence limitations, and proposed future acceleration methods are retained without substantive revision.

D1.justification: Section 7 newly discloses a 24-core CPU, 32 GB RAM, one NVIDIA RTX 4090 GPU, and Python 3.8. This adds reproducibility information without establishing an environment change. The implementation descriptions and code-access link are otherwise retained.

R1.justification: The cited works and substantive comparisons with prior research are unchanged. Reference entries shift across pages, while the new publication and review information does not alter research positioning.

P1.justification: v4 makes localized copyedits, including 'draw' to 'drawn' and 'forth' to 'fourth', and adds publication/review information. The narrative, section order, and appendix organization remain substantially unchanged.

P2.justification: Publication headers and first-page review information produce modest text, table, and figure reflow. Table 1 and Figures 1–10 retain their structure and visual content; no display is added, removed, or redrawn.

improvement.justification: v4 resolves the inconsistency between Section 7.3's 30-epoch statement and Figure 3's existing 60/80-epoch curves, adds useful computing-environment details, and aligns the proof outline's averaging with Appendix I. These improve consistency and reproducibility, while the methods, central results, and empirical evidence remain unchanged.
